title: juncus inflexus f. equisetosus
intro: Juncus inflexus f. equisetosus, commonly known as soft rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Juncaceae family. It is known for its therapeutic properties, which include soothing and calming effects, and is often used to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety. The health benefits of Juncus inflexus f. equisetosus include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects.
